name: patolabs
description: Claude Code and Codex plugins for framing, delivering, and shipping software.

plugins.name: foundry
plugins.description: Idea→merge: guided brainstorm → ADRs + precise issues → value-first roadmap → gated execution loop, over a pluggable tracker + code-host. Judgment in the skills, invariants in the code.

plugins.name: ship-ios
plugins.description: Merge→live for iOS apps: locale-neutral changelog → per-locale release notes → Xcode Cloud build → TestFlight gate → App Store submit. Composes with Foundry by data.

plugins.name: gauge
plugins.description: Read-only quota gauge: Codex, Claude, Linear and GitHub Actions counters with source and read time; unreadable data is unknown, never zero.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Session hand-over: writes a verified, secret-free resume state at the end of a session, as a local owner-only file outside git tracking.

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Pinned REA/Ghidra tooling, registry of authorised targets and a reproducible evidence-backed inventory of an authorised target.

plugins.name: witness
plugins.description: Proves a change of an iOS app in the simulator (xcodebuild and xcrun simctl only, scripted navigation by deep link or UI test) or of a local web page in a headless Chromium-family browser: tests, install, launch, screenshot and a dated report; before/after comparison.
